cards.text: Ezekiel is a priest living among the exiles in the land of the Chaldeans (Ezekiel 1:1-3), and in a vision of Jerusalem he just watched the glory of the LORD stop at the entrance of the east gate of the LORD's house (Ezekiel 10:19). Now the Spirit lifts Ezekiel up and brings him to that same gate, no stairs, no ladder, and friend, I need a running start and THREE tries just to hop my gold base up onto the counter. Twenty-five men are standing there, and two of them get named: Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah.

cards.question: Jaazaniah and Pelatiah are standing at the east gate. Who are these two men?

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Ezekiel, calls him "Son of man," and tells him exactly what kind of men these twenty-five are.

cards.question: The LORD tells Ezekiel these twenty-five men ___ evil and give ___ counsel in the city.

cards.text: And they've got a saying: "Is not the time near to build houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat." Twenty-five men at one gate with a SLOGAN, friend, and I've been trying to come up with one for my bakery since the day I got here and I've still got NOTHING.

cards.question: The LORD tells Ezekiel to keep quiet and leave the twenty-five men at the east gate alone.

cards.text: The Spirit of the LORD falls on Ezekiel, and he's told to declare what the LORD says. It starts like this: "That is what you are thinking, O house of Israel…"

cards.question: God says He knows the thoughts that come up in the minds of the house of Israel.

cards.text: Then God names what's been done: "You have multiplied those you killed in this city and filled its streets with the dead." I think this one hurts, friend.

cards.question: God takes the cooking pot picture these men use and turns it around. Who does He say the meat in the pot really is?

answers.text: The slain laid within the city
The men standing at the gate

cards.question: God says He will leave these men right where they are, inside the city.
These men are afraid of something, and God says that's exactly what He'll bring against them: the ___.

cards.text: Out of the city, into the hands of foreigners, down by the sword: that's where God says these men are headed. He'll judge them even to the borders of Israel, and then, He says, they will know that He is the LORD.
God says the city won't be a pot for them, and they won't be the meat in it. And that line about judging them even to the borders of Israel? He says it again.

cards.question: God gives His reason: these men haven't followed His statutes or practiced His ordinances. Instead, they've followed the ordinances of the ___ around them.

cards.text: Ezekiel is still prophesying when something happens to Pelatiah son of Benaiah, one of the two men named at the gate.

cards.question: While Ezekiel is still prophesying, what happens to Pelatiah son of Benaiah?
Ezekiel falls facedown and cries out in a loud voice. What does he ask the Lord GOD?

answers.text: Will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end
Will You bring Pelatiah back to life again
Will You send me home to the exiles now

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel about his brothers, his fellow exiles and the whole house of Israel. Turns out the people of Jerusalem have been talking about them, friend, and that's the group chat NOBODY wants to find out about.

cards.question: What have the people of Jerusalem been saying about Ezekiel's fellow exiles?

answers.text: They are far away from the LORD
They will be coming home soon
They are the true leaders now

cards.question: The people of Jerusalem also say the land has been given to them as a possession.

cards.text: Then God gives Ezekiel His answer to declare. He says He sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries.

cards.question: Far away in those countries, God says that for a little while He has been a ___ for the exiles.

cards.text: And then the Lord GOD makes the exiles a promise: He'll gather them from the peoples and bring them together from every country where they've been scattered. Friend, I spill ONE bag of chocolate chips and I'm still finding them under the oven a week later.

cards.question: Once He gathers the exiles, God says He'll give back to them the ___ of Israel.
When the exiles return to the land, God says they'll leave its detestable things right where they are.

cards.text: And then comes my favorite part, friend. God says He'll give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them.

cards.question: God says He'll take out one kind of heart and put in another. Which heart does He remove?
In place of the heart of stone, God gives them a heart of ___.
Why does God give the exiles a new heart and a new spirit?

answers.text: So they may follow His statutes
So they may rebuild the walls
So they may rule the nations

cards.question: God says of them, "Then they will be My people, and I will be their God."

cards.text: But there's a warning in it too: for those whose hearts pursue detestable things and abominations, God says He'll bring their conduct down on their own heads. Friend, it's like the dough, because whatever you put into the batch is exactly what comes out of the oven.

Then the cherubim spread their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel is above them. The glory of the LORD rises up from within the city, and friend, I'll be honest, that one gives me chills.

cards.question: The glory of the LORD leaves the city and stands over the mountain ___ of the city.

cards.text: Then the Spirit lifts Ezekiel up and carries him back to Chaldea, to the exiles, in the vision given by the Spirit of God. And then the vision goes up from him.

cards.question: Back home with the exiles in Chaldea, what does Ezekiel do with this whole vision?

answers.text: He tells them everything the LORD showed him
He keeps every part of it to himself
He shares it only with the other priests
